courts.2: M M H S S, Thalassery

event.trophy: C.B.C Warrior, Abraham Thomas and Robin Antony Memorial Ever Rolling Trophies

rules.M: Top 3 teams from Pool A and Pool B, and one each from Pool C and Pool D, qualify for the knockout stage. The winner of C1 vs D1 chooses W1 or W2.
rules.W: Top 2 teams from Pools A, B and C qualify for the knockout stage. A1 and B1 are seeded directly to the semifinals.
